title: 给客户高管汇报，怎样把方案价值说到点上？
topic: 面向决策者说明业务价值并确认重点

source.title: Communicate Successfully with Executives
source.section: Frame Communications Based on Your Audience; Rule of Three
source.type: Salesforce Trailhead 公开销售培训
source.context: Salesforce Trailhead 关于高管沟通的销售培训单元。
paragraphs: What are your business priorities? What are the executive’s?
What are the relevant metrics to your goal?
Why should an executive care about the solutions you are proposing?

Remember to also prepare open-ended questions for the executive, as opposed to closed yes/no questions. For example, asking, “Are you happy with our partnership?” is a closed question which doesn’t lead to much new information. Instead, ask, “What can we do to make our partnership better?”
Another great technique when communicating with executives is the Rule of Three. This technique can help regardless of which type of executive you are engaged with.
Provide the three most important reasons: Ensure they hear the most pressing three priorities before the conversation ends.
Project logic, confidence, and decisiveness: You sound logical, prepared, confident, and decisive when you speak.
translations: 你的业务重点是什么？这位高管的业务重点又是什么？
哪些指标与你的目标相关？
你提出的方案为什么值得高管关注？
还要为高管准备开放式问题，而不是只能回答“是”或“否”的封闭式问题。例如，问“您对我们的合作满意吗？”很难得到新的信息。可以改问：“我们可以做些什么，让合作变得更好？”
与高管沟通的另一种有效方法是“三点法”。无论面对哪类高管，这种方法都能派上用场。
提供最重要的三个理由：确保在谈话结束前，让对方听到最紧迫的三个重点。
表达要有逻辑、信心和决断力，让人听出你准备充分、思路清楚。

fullTextHeadings.0: Frame Communications Based on Your Audience

notes.explain: 让对方展开说明，不只回答“是”或“否”。
notes.example: What would make this partnership more valuable for your team?

notes.explain: 把最重要的三个理由优先讲清楚，方便高管抓住重点。
notes.example: There are three reasons this change matters to the business.

notes.explain: 先讲最关键的理由，避免把有限时间花在次要信息上。
notes.example: Let me start with the three most important reasons.

scenario.title: 模拟汇报：向客户高管介绍入职流程改进
english: A customer’s vice president has ten minutes to review your proposal.
Your team expects a new onboarding flow to reduce time to first successful use from five business days to three.
You need to connect the expected result to one metric and check whether faster onboarding is a current priority.
chinese: 客户的一位副总裁只有十分钟听取方案。
团队预计新的入职流程能把客户首次成功使用产品的时间从五个工作日缩短到三个。
你需要用一个指标说明预期结果，并确认更快上手是否是对方当前的重点。

firstAttempt.prompt: 客户高管只有十分钟听方案。请用英文概括预期业务结果、说出一项衡量指标，并确认这是否符合对方当前重点。
firstAttempt.sample: We expect the new onboarding flow to reduce time to first successful use from five business days to three. We’ll track the median time from account setup to first successful use. Does faster onboarding align with your priority of helping customers get value sooner?
firstAttempt.rationale: 先讲预期结果和衡量方式，再把方案与客户的业务重点对齐。

taskPhrases.example: We expect this change to reduce time to first successful use from five business days to three.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们预计这项调整会把客户首次成功使用所需时间从五个工作日缩短到三个。

taskPhrases.example: We’ll track the median time to first successful use.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们会跟踪首次成功使用所需时间的中位数。

taskPhrases.word: Does this align with your priority of…?
taskPhrases.meaning: 这符合您当前……的重点吗？
taskPhrases.example: Does this align with your priority of helping customers get value sooner?
taskPhrases.translation: 这符合您希望客户更快获得价值的当前重点吗？

words.example: Is reducing onboarding time a priority for your team this quarter?
words.translation: 缩短入职时间是你们团队本季度的重点吗？
words.note: 和业务场景搭配时，常指团队当前最重视的目标。

words.example: Time to first successful use is a relevant metric for this onboarding goal.
words.translation: 首次成功使用所需时间是衡量这项入职目标的相关指标。
words.note: 指标要能直接反映目标是否实现。

words.meaning: 开放式的；允许展开回答的
words.example: What would make this proposal more useful for your team?
words.translation: 怎样才能让这项提案对你们团队更有用？
words.note: 开放式问题通常以 what、how 或 why 开头。

structure.original: What are the relevant metrics to your goal?
analysis: relevant to 表示“与……相关”，用来检查指标是否真的对应目标。
goal 与 metric 要成对出现：先说希望改变什么，再说用什么数字衡量。
structure.transfer: Which metric is most relevant to the goal of reducing repeat support requests?

rewrite.bad: This project is good and will make customers happier.
rewrite.good: We expect this change to reduce time to first successful use from five business days to three. We’ll track the median time to first successful use. Does faster onboarding align with your priority this quarter?
rewrite.translation: 我们预计这项调整会把客户首次成功使用所需时间从五个工作日缩短到三个。我们会跟踪客户首次成功使用所需时间的中位数。更快上手符合您本季度的重点吗？
rewrite.pattern: We expect [change] to [business result]. We’ll track [metric]. Does this align with your priority of [goal]?

cloze.prompt: We ______ the new flow to reduce onboarding time.
cloze.why: expect ... to 表达团队对结果的预期。

cloze.prompt: We’ll ______ the median time to first successful use.
cloze.why: track a metric 表示持续跟踪一个指标。

cloze.prompt: Does this ______ with your priority this quarter?
cloze.why: align with 表示与某个重点或目标保持一致。

dictation.text: What are the relevant metrics to your goal?
dictation.why: 注意 relevant 和 metrics 的重音；句子问的是“哪些指标能衡量这个目标”。

dictation.text: Does faster onboarding align with your priority of helping customers get value sooner?
dictation.why: 听辨 Does ... align with 的疑问句结构。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们预计这项调整会把客户首次成功使用所需时间从五个工作日缩短到三个。
translationPractice.answer: We expect this change to reduce time to first successful use from five business days to three.
translationPractice.why: 把预期结果说具体：从开户到客户首次成功使用，预计由五个工作日缩短至三个。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们会跟踪首次成功使用所需时间的中位数。
translationPractice.answer: We’ll track the median time to first successful use.
translationPractice.why: track 后面接需要持续观察的指标。

translationPractice.prompt: 这符合您希望客户更快获得价值的当前重点吗？
translationPractice.answer: Does this align with your priority of helping customers get value sooner?
translationPractice.why: 用 Does this align with...? 确认方案和对方重点是否一致。

choice.prompt: 高管问“这项方案为什么值得我关注？”，哪种回答最有用？
options: It is a very exciting project and the team has worked hard.
It should reduce onboarding time from five days to three; we’ll track time to first successful use. Does faster onboarding support your current goal?
We have many features planned and can share the full list later.
choice.why: 第二种回答给出业务结果、衡量指标，并确认是否符合对方重点。

output.prompt: 你向财务负责人汇报一项自动化对账方案。请说明预期结果、提出一项衡量指标，并确认更快完成月结是否符合财务团队当前重点。
output.sample: We expect the automation to reduce reconciliation time from six hours to two. We’ll track the median time to close each monthly reconciliation. Does a faster close align with your team’s priority this quarter? If so, could we review the pilot results together next Friday?
check: 说出自动化方案要带来的结果
提出一个能衡量结果的指标
确认该结果是否符合财务团队的当前重点
